verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a first-party Batch API for processing groups of requests asynchronously, which covers the async batch-submission half of the story. Nothing in the evidence pack states a batch discount versus real-time pricing. missing for 10: documented batch pricing discount versus real-time rates, batch job lifecycle/limits details, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch usage.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: The Batch API lets you process groups of requests asynchronously, making it perfect for workloads where you don't need immediate results
